text:
zoe: Quick thought  puzzle night + snack exchange on the roof this Thu 7pm? Low-key, bring a snack to share or just come for the puzzles. :jigsaw: :cookie:

mike: Love it. Can we do a 15-min shoutout/kudos round before we start? Been a while since we did those sticky-note kudos.

lina: Yes please. I'll bring stickers and a marker board for notes.

dan: I'll bring a 500-piece travel puzzle and a deck of Trivia HQ cards. Also non-alc seltzers.

rui: Count me in. Veg snacks from me (mini spring rolls). Any nut allergies?

anna: I'm allergic to peanuts  no problem if people label things?

zoe: Yep we'll label everything. Plan B if windy/rainy is the common room on floor 3. Final decision by 4pm Thu.

mike: I'll bring a little prize (gift card) for the first finished puzzle team. Friendly competition only. :trophy:

lina: For the kudos round, I can run a quick template: each person writes 1 line of appreciation, 1 silly emoji, stick to the board. Keep it under 2 minutes each.

rui: Also bringing a tiny Bluetooth speaker and fairy lights.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Puzzle Night & Snack Swap" Thu 19:00  reminder at 16:00.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Puzzle Night + Snack Swap & Kudos" Thu 19:00  guests updated. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2519001112

zoe: Poll for snacks/drink focus  react: :cookie: for baked goods, :leafy_green: for savory/veg, :beer: for beer & wine, :coffee: for non-alc.

mike: :cookie: :coffee:

lina: :leafy_green:

dan: :beer: :leafy_green:

rui: :leafy_green:

zoe: Cool  looks like savory + some sweets. I'll post a mini shopping list. If you want to claim something reply with the item.

mike: I'll grab napkins + paper plates.

lina: I'll handle markers + stickers for kudos board.

rui: Bringing spring rolls and toothpicks.

kudos-bot: New kudos channel message posted: "Drop your kudos at the Puzzle Night board!"

zoe: Thanks all! If anyone wants to bring a folding chair or blanket for the roof, say so. See you Thu :) :sparkles:
